dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Oars made from new bamboo feel better. Would you like to go to Qiaoying Village by raft?

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Oars are made from new or old bamboo based on each ferryman's preference.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Strictly speaking, old and new bamboo from Qingce Village have the same strength so long as they're cut at the right time and processed the right way.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: But every ferryman's hands are different, so they make different choices.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: The ferryman who taught me to sing said that it's just like tea, where the same leaves have different flavors after being processed by different tea makers.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Some of us are accustomed to using oars made out of new bamboo, and some are accustomed to using oars made out of old bamboo. We each have our unique boating rhythm and hum melodies in unique ways...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Every boatman in Chenyu Vale will hum songs while sailing, and these songs are passed down to the young from the old.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Nobody knows who composed these songs many years ago, but they have been subtly engraved into the memories of most locals...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: The line that touched me the most is...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: "Sun and earth from each other divide, the eternal whirlpool that never churns, the beautiful jade concealed within..."

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: No worries. There will always be a boatman waiting for you by the river here in Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: We've arrived at Qiaoying Village. May we meet again, if fate wills it so!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ride the bamboo raft to Qiaoying Village

dialogues.speaker: Sun Rao
dialogues.text: Please, take your seat and we'll set out.
